title: Show content as soon as possible

statement.en: Show useful content or a meaningful placeholder as soon as possible while loading.
statement.ja: loading中は有用なcontentまたは意味のあるplaceholderをできるだけ早く表示する。

conditions: A blank initial state can look like a problem with the app or game.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Loading experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるLoadingの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。
